g1.label: 1. Placement begins on...
g1.why: The recording says the placement begins on Monday the third of March.

g2.label: 2. The placement lasts...
g2.why: The recording says it is a two-week work-experience placement.

g3.label: 3. Where to go if you have no company?
g3.why: The recording says to go to the careers office if you haven't found a company.

g4.label: 4. What must students keep?
g4.why: The recording says students must keep a daily diary.

g5.label: 5. What does the employer fill in?
g5.why: The recording says the employer fills in a short report at the end.

g6.label: 6. Where is Leon going?
g6.why: The recording says Leon is going to work at a car garage.

g7.label: 7. What does Sara want to become?
g7.why: The recording says Sara wants to be a teacher one day.

g8.label: 8. Who else must be called if ill?
g8.why: The recording says if ill, students must phone both the company and the school.
